editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: D Prime (formerly Doo Prime) scores 4.05 out of 10 in NAFT's 2026 trust assessment. All retail accounts route to offshore entities in Vanuatu (VFSC 700238) or Seychelles (FSA SD074/SD090) — no investor compensation exists under either licence. The FCA and ASIC registrations the group advertises do not cover retail trading accounts. A Doo Group call centre in Kuala Lumpur was raided by Malaysian police in August 2025 as part of a wider financial scam investigation. A May 2026 publicly reported complaint documents profits being deducted from a trader accused of high-frequency trading. Spreads and platform choice look competitive on paper, but the regulatory and reputational risk profile makes this unsuitable for any trader who cannot afford to lose their entire deposit.
